description: Boot sequence executed as ad-hoc context load rather than running workflows/boot/workflow.md. state.yaml was never initialized (status: not-started). Steps 01-07 were skipped entirely. Knox/Plaud spawn (step-01 task), Phase 2 parallel task fire (step-02), Ralph verification gate (step-03), and hard completion gate (step-07) all bypassed. Plaud ingest was not run as a result.
correction: Boot must initialize state.yaml, execute all 7 steps in order, spawn Knox fire-and-forget during step-01, run all Phase 2 tasks in parallel during step-02, invoke Ralph verification in step-03 before proceeding, and pass the step-07 hard gate before reporting boot complete.
systemic_fix: The boot workflow needs a stronger enforcement hook — the system currently relies on Master voluntarily reading and following workflow.md rather than being gated on it. Rigby should evaluate whether a pre-boot check (verify state.yaml initialized before any briefing output is allowed) can be added as an architectural constraint.
